clue.text: Attractive late Norman design

indicators.note: a design here is a rearranged pattern, so the letters of the two words before it are laid out afresh

explanation.surface: Admiring the handsome look of some late Norman architecture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'design' signals the anagram of LATE NORMAN; 'Attractive' reads as praise for the design but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something decorative is pleasing to look at, so it is attractive.

clue.text: Get ready to take advantage

definitions.meaning: ready is slang for cash, so getting ready is turning something into money
to profit from a situation or opportunity

explanation.definitionFit: Converting assets into money is getting ready cash, and the same phrase means exploiting a chance for profit.

clue.text: Rex with nothing invested in advanced country

indicators.note: invested means put inside, so the king and the zero go into the word for advanced

parts.note: advanced means came on
R is the abbreviation for Rex, king
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A king with no money put into a developed nation's economy.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a nation in central Africa, so it is a country.

clue.text: Succumb when one's in good humour

annotationWithheld.why: Succumb when one's in good humour (4,2): GIVEN (when) with I (one) inside gives the answer, but 'good humour' then does no job; no parse found uses every word
annotationWithheld.clue: Succumb when one's in good humour

clue.text: Engaging kind of expert

parts.note: like means of the same kind, as in 'and the like'
expert means able, skilled

explanation.surface: Describing a charming sort of specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone engaging is pleasant and easy to warm to, so pleasing company.

clue.text: Sounds like a lovely Australian island

indicators.note: says the word for lovely in Australian slang is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: beaut is Australian slang for something lovely

explanation.surface: Looks like a description of a pretty island off Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: The island is not Australian at all: Bute is a Scottish island in the Firth of Clyde; 'Australian' just marks the slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Bute is an island in the Firth of Clyde, off western Scotland.

clue.text: Left off a substantial section

indicators.note: off means taken away, so the abbreviation for left is dropped from the word for substantial

parts.note: substantial means real, solid

explanation.surface: Something leaving out a big part.
explanation.definitionFit: A region or zone of a larger whole is a part of it, a section.

clue.text: American's very spiteful about Arab mercenary

parts.note: A is the abbreviation for American

indicators.note: about means around, so the word for very spiteful wraps the abbreviation for Arab

parts.note: very spiteful means vicious

explanation.surface: A nasty American complaining about a hired Arab soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mercenary' looks like a noun for a hired soldier, but here it is the adjective meaning money-grabbing.
explanation.definitionFit: Being mercenary means acting only for money, which is greed.

clue.text: Imitating current a trend to some extent

parts.note: after means in imitation of, as in a painting after Rembrandt
A is the symbol for amps, the unit of electric current
a trend is a fashion

explanation.surface: Copying the latest craze up to a point.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue's 'a' is a link word; 'current' supplies the A, as the amp symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in a rough, partial way is doing it only somewhat, to some extent.

clue.text: A quiet man in a race to reach Asian city

indicators.note: in means the three pieces before it sit inside the race

parts.note: the TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man
sh is a call for quiet
Ken is a man's name

explanation.surface: A silent man entering a race to get to a city in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Tashkent is the capital of Uzbekistan in Central Asia.

clue.text: Point to fifty, equal number

parts.note: E is east, a point of the compass
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
equal means even, level

explanation.surface: A score drawn level at fifty points.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the count after ten, a number.

clue.text: Building extension on the list?

parts.note: to list is to lean, as a ship does
to can mean on or against, as in setting a shoulder to the wheel

explanation.surface: Asking whether an annex is on the agenda.
explanation.walkthrough: 'list' reads as an agenda but is the verb a tilting ship does.
explanation.definitionFit: A shed whose roof rests against a wall of a larger structure is an extension of it.

clue.text: Car's exhaust a blockhead's cutting into

indicators.note: cutting into means the pieces before it break into the word for exhaust

parts.note: to exhaust a supply is to run out of it
the head, first letter, of block is B

explanation.surface: A dimwit tampering with a car's exhaust pipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exhaust' looks like a car part but is the verb meaning use up.
explanation.definitionFit: A small, light motor vehicle for short trips is a kind of car.

clue.text: Winning team ends up losing — it's chaotic

parts.note: being up is winning, ahead
a side is a team
being down is losing, behind

explanation.surface: A leading team ends up beaten: what a mess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ends up' and 'it's' are link words joining the charade to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something turned over and in total disorder is a mess, chaotic.

clue.text: It's a tragedy if the old man's not freed

indicators.note: freed means released from its order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the word man with its S

explanation.surface: Sighing that it would be sad if the old fellow stayed locked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'freed' signals the anagram of IF THE O MANS NOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Timon of Athens is a tragic play by Shakespeare, so a tragedy.

clue.text: Claim support

definitions.meaning: to keep up or provide for

explanation.definitionFit: To insist a point is true is to assert it, and to keep a family is to provide for it.

clue.text: Lyrical mood music?

parts.note: tone means mood, atmosphere
lyrical work points to a poem

explanation.surface: Music that sets a poetic mood.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchestral piece illustrating a story or scene is music of a descriptive kind.

clue.text: Wretched having endless row about one US state

indicators.note: about means around, so the joined pieces go round the letter for one

parts.note: wretched means ill, poorly

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the word for row is dropped

parts.note: a row is a din, noise
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Feeling awful after an argument about a single American state.
explanation.definitionFit: Illinois is a state in the Midwest of the United States.

clue.text: Recently find old student is in luck

indicators.note: is in means the letter for student sits inside the word for luck

parts.note: fate means fortune, luck
L is a learner, a student driver

explanation.surface: Discovering a past pupil has been fortunate.
explanation.definitionFit: Something happening lately has happened in recent times.

clue.text: Lacking authority it comes to nothing

parts.note: no means without, lacking
a body is an authority, an official organisation

explanation.surface: Without power, it amounts to zero.
explanation.definitionFit: A nonentity, a person of no importance, counts for zero.

clue.text: Bob cat has a blackhead

parts.note: the head, first letter, of black is B
an ounce is the snow leopard, a wild cat

explanation.surface: A cat called Bob with a spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bob' looks like a name but is the verb to spring up and down.
explanation.definitionFit: To bob is to move up and down, to spring back.

clue.text: Reflecting clear lining of stone colour

indicators.note: lining means the turned word goes round the abbreviation for stone
reflecting means mirrored, so the word for clear is read backwards

parts.note: to clear a fence is to leap it
ST is the abbreviation for stone, the British weight

explanation.surface: A pale stone colour as seen in a clear reflection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reflecting' turns LEAP into PAEL, which then lines ST to give PA-ST-EL.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft, pale shade is a kind of colour.

clue.text: Murder victim featured in Rabelais

indicators.note: featured in means the name sits inside the French author's name

explanation.surface: A murdered character appears in the works of Rabelais.
explanation.walkthrough: Abel was killed by his brother Cain in the Book of Genesis.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Abel was killed by his brother Cain, the first homicide.

clue.text: Seizes one document that carries weight

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: that carries means the document holds the weight inside it

parts.note: MS is a manuscript, a document
a pound is a weight

explanation.surface: Confiscates a single heavy paper.
explanation.definitionFit: To take goods into legal custody is to confiscate them.

clue.text: A secret is unfolding about Pole's struggle

indicators.note: about means around, so the rearranged letters go round the Pole
unfolding means opening out, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: N is the north pole

explanation.surface: A Pole's fight as a hidden truth comes out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfolding' makes RESISTACE from A SECRET IS, and 'about' puts N in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Opposing or fighting against something is a struggle.

clue.text: Said to provoke bird's cries

indicators.note: said means spoken, so the word for provoke is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: to provoke is to cause

explanation.surface: Something that sets off the calls of a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Crows and rooks make harsh calls, the cries of a bird.
